newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile June industrial output climbs seven pct.
newsitem.headline: Chile June industrial output climbs seven pct.

text.p: Chilean industrial production grew seven percent in June from the same month last year, with sales rising 3.6 percent in the same period, said the National Statistics Institute.
The figures showed industrial output, excluding copper refining, increased two percent in the first six months of the year with sales up 3.2 percent.
Areas with sharpest increases in June included food, up 11.5 percent; chemical products, up 19 percent; and the manufacture of plastic products, which rose 29.5 percent on the same month of 1996.
Declines were seen in oil refining, down 10.2 percent; the basic iron and steel industry, down 8.6 percent; and paper production which dropped 5.2 percent.
